title: Widget title does not change when choosing different widget through alternate 5.27.3
line: Switching a System Monitor widget to another one with Show Alternatives now actually shows the new widget instead of the old one.
explanation: Show Alternatives creates the new widget and then copies the old widget's config into it, so settings survive the switch. All System Monitor widgets (Network Speed, Memory Usage, Total CPU Use…) are the same applet with different preset config, so the copy overwrote the new preset with the old one and the widget kept the old title and sensors. The copy is now skipped when the new widget is a variant (X-Plasma-RootPath) of the same root applet as the old one; every other switch still keeps its config.

commits.message:
shell: don't copy the old config to a variant of the same applet

Switching a System Monitor widget to another one through Show
Alternatives copied the old config over the new widget, and since these
widgets only differ by their config, nothing changed. Now we skip that.

BUG: 467392

media.caption: Network Speed widget, Show Alternatives, choosing Memory Usage
Before: the new Memory Usage widget still shows Network Speed with download/upload rates
Same steps with the fix: Network Speed widget, Show Alternatives, choosing Memory Usage
After: the widget becomes Memory Usage
Memory Usage → System Monitor Sensor (keeps the memory sensors, as before) → Total CPU Use now shows CPU

reviews.text: The root cause diagnosis and location in AlternativesHelper::loadAlternative() are right, but using X-Plasma-RootPath equality to skip config copying introduces a major regression for other Plasma applets that share a QML package via X-Plasma-RootPath. Specifically, org.kde.plasma.icontasks sets X-Plasma-RootPath to org.kde.plasma.taskmanager and org.kde.plasma.kickerdash sets X-Plasma-RootPath to org.kde.plasma.kicker, so switching from Task Manager to Icons-Only Task Manager (or Application Menu to Application Dashboard) would match oldRoot == newRoot and wipe pinned apps and settings, while still copying asymmetrically in the reverse direction. Skip config copying only via an explicit opt-out metadata flag on applets whose identity lives in their preset config, rather than inferring it from X-Plasma-RootPath.
changes: Replace the X-Plasma-RootPath heuristic in shell/alternativeshelper.cpp with an explicit opt-out metadata property on System Monitor preset applets (or a libplasma/metadata flag checked by AlternativesHelper) so applets that merely share a QML package still preserve their config.

Verify that Show Alternatives between org.kde.plasma.taskmanager <-> org.kde.plasma.icontasks and org.kde.plasma.kicker <-> org.kde.plasma.kickerdash preserves pinned apps and settings in both directions.
